verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Zoho CRM has workflows triggered by record events (for example, routing leads or updating fields when a deal closes), but nothing documents scheduling a job or workflow to run on a recurring time-based schedule. 'Automate repetitive tasks' describes event-driven automation, and 'check the job status periodically' describes user-side polling; neither is a recurring scheduler. Scheduling is a fair axis for a CRM, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
